name: Two Buttons
look: A two-panel comic. Top: a white-gloved hand hovers over two big red buttons on a gray control panel. Bottom: a man in a red costume, sweating heavily, wipes his forehead with a handkerchief and stares ahead in panic.
use: Each button is labeled with one of two conflicting options, often two things the person can't bear to give up, and the sweating man is labeled as whoever is agonizing over the choice.
slots: who is stuck choosing (the sweating man)
describe: cartoon man sweating over which red button to press
hand hovering over a pair of red buttons then a guy wiping his forehead
nervous superhero can't decide between two choices
comic guy dabbing sweat with a cloth over a hard decision
two panel comic of a tough choice between red buttons
origin: A webcomic by artist Jake Clark, posted on his Tumblr.
